info.title: KayFit + FitKeep Unified API
info.description:
Unified backend for the KayFit (nutrition tracking) and FitKeep (training) apps.

**Authentication:** All protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

**Localisation:** Pass `Accept-Language: ru` or `Accept-Language: en` to receive translated content where available.

**Token lifecycle:**
- Access token: 15 min, JWT
- Refresh token: 30 days, opaque (stored hashed in DB)

post.description: Create a new user account with email and password. Returns access and refresh tokens.
Authenticate with email and password. Returns access and refresh tokens.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new short-lived access token.
Invalidates the provided refresh token. The access token remains valid until expiry.

get.description: Returns basic profile info for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the user's account and all associated data.

post.description: Record user's consent (or revocation) for AI data processing. Required before AI features can be used.
Register or update a Firebase Cloud Messaging token for push notifications.

get.description: Returns combined profile: user info, nutrition profile, training profile, and active subscription. Used by the app on startup to determine onboarding state.

patch.description: Partially update fullname and/or email. Only provided fields are changed.

post.description: Record user's AI data processing consent. Must be true before AI chat features are unlocked.

get.description: Returns the stored nutrition/health data for the current user.

post.description: Upsert user's nutrition/health data (weight, height, goal, restrictions). Used to personalise calorie recommendations and AI diet advice.

get.description: Returns the stored fitness data for the current user.

post.description: Upsert user's fitness data (experience, preferred training type, injuries, etc.). Used for training program matching and AI workout personalisation.
Record a client-side action for analytics. Duplicate actions within 30 seconds are deduplicated. Used for funnel tracking and admin dashboards.

get.description: Returns training status for each day of the current calendar week. Status values: 'completed', 'pending', 'none'.

post.description: Deletes all training history: exercise results, schedules, and program assignments. Used when the user wants to restart from scratch.
Register or update a Firebase Cloud Messaging token to enable push notifications.

get.description: Returns all available training programs, optionally filtered by category. Supports i18n via Accept-Language header (ru/en).

schema.title: Response Get Programs Api V1 Training Programs Get

get.description: Returns workouts from programs in the 'free' category (no subscription required).

schema.title: Response Get Free Programs Api V1 Training Programs Free Get

post.description: Scores all programs against the user's quiz answers and returns a ranked list. Use to suggest the best program before the user makes a selection.

schema.title: Response Match Programs Api V1 Training Programs Match Post

post.description: Assigns the chosen program to the user and generates a personalised workout schedule based on their preferred training days from the quiz.
Asynchronously runs program matching and schedule generation in the background. Returns a task_id immediately. Poll `/programs/generate/{task_id}/status` for completion.

get.description: Check the status of a background generation task. Status: 'running', 'success', 'error'.
Returns a program's metadata and its list of workouts.
Returns all exercises in a specific workout, with defaults for sets/reps/weight.

schema.title: Response Get Workout Exercises Api V1 Training Programs  Program Id  Workouts  Workout Id  Exercises Get

get.description: Returns the user's active program and their full training schedule (all workout sessions with dates and statuses).

get.summary: Get exercises for a scheduled session
get.description: Returns exercises for a specific workout session, applying any user-specific exercise overrides. Includes default and user-customised sets/reps/weight.

schema.title: Response Get Schedule Exercises Api V1 Training Schedule  Schedule Id  Exercises Get

get.description: Returns full exercise details for a session: description, video, approach list with reps/weight, previous results, and next exercise preview.

patch.description: Move a scheduled workout to a different date.

post.description: Save completed sets for an exercise. Set `training_complete=true` on the last exercise to mark the entire workout session as done.
Manually log a max weight for an exercise. Only saved if it exceeds the current record.

get.description: Returns exercises that can substitute the given exercise (same muscle group / difficulty).

schema.title: Response Get Alternatives Api V1 Training Exercises  Exercise Id  Alternatives Get

post.description: Substitute one or more exercises in a scheduled workout with alternatives. Overrides are stored per-user and do not affect other users' programs.

get.description: Returns aggregated exercise results from the past 7 days: max weight and total reps per exercise.

schema.title: Response Last Week Results Api V1 Training Results Last Week Get

post.description: Calculates an estimated date to reach the target body-fat percentage based on current metrics, training intensity, and workout frequency from the user's program.

Add a food entry to the daily diary. Provide either food_id (from DB) or food_name (custom). All micronutrient and vitamin fields are optional — pass them when recognised from photo/voice/text to preserve the full nutritional profile in the diary.

get.description: Returns all meal entries for the given date plus a daily summary (total calories, protein, fat, carbs, meal count).

patch.description: Partially update a meal. Only supplied non-null fields are changed.

delete.description: Permanently removes a meal from the diary.

get.description: Full-text search in the food DB by name (case-insensitive substring match).

schema.title: Response Search Foods Api V1 Nutrition Foods Search Get

get.description: Fetch a food item using its EAN/UPC barcode. Used by the in-app barcode scanner.
Returns the most recent nutrition targets for the current user.

post.description: Upsert daily nutrition targets (calories, macros, water). Creates a new entry for today or updates today's existing entry.

get.summary: Nutrition statistics for a date range
get.description: Returns daily aggregated totals (calories, protein, fat, carbs) for each day in the requested range. Use for charts and progress tracking.

post.description: Parse a free-text description of what was eaten. Claude splits the text into individual food items, then looks up or generates full KBJU + vitamins/minerals per actual portion. Use the returned items to populate the Add Meal form or log them directly.

Upload a JPEG/PNG/WEBP image of a meal. Claude Vision identifies each food item and estimates portion weight, then the service enriches results with full nutrient data. Pass `language` form field as 'ru' or 'en' to control response language.

Upload an audio file (MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, WebM). OpenAI Whisper transcribes it, then Claude parses the transcript into food items and enriches with full nutrient data. The response includes `transcript` so the user can confirm what was heard.

post.summary: Send a message to AI assistant
post.description: Send a message and receive an AI response. The system automatically routes the message to the appropriate specialised agent: nutrition, training, or general. Pass thread_id to maintain conversation context across messages.

get.description: Returns messages in chronological order (oldest first). Optionally filter by thread_id. Maximum 200 messages.

delete.description: Permanently deletes all chat messages for the current user.

get.description: Returns the full equipment catalog grouped by category, each with items and options. Use to render the equipment selection screen. Supports i18n via Accept-Language.

schema.title: Response Get Catalog Api V1 Equipment  Get

get.description: Returns the equipment items selected by the current user.

schema.title: Response Get User Equipment Api V1 Equipment User Get

put.description: Full replacement of the user's equipment list. All previous entries are deleted and replaced with the provided list.

get.description: Returns all quiz questions with answer options for the current language. Questions are returned as a keyed dict — iterate in any order or present selected keys.

post.description: Upsert a single quiz answer for the current user. For many_buttons, pass a list of ints. For one_button, pass a single int. For text questions, pass a string.
Fetch stored answers for specific question keys. Used to check onboarding completeness (e.g. check 'current_fat_percentage' to see if quiz was done).

get.description: Returns all saved quiz answers for the current user, ordered by question creation time.

post.description: Sends a consultation request notification to the trainer team via Telegram. The user's preferred date and time are included in the notification.

get.description: Returns all available subscription plans ordered by price. Includes trial and free plans. Use to build the paywall/tariffs screen.

schema.title: Response Get Plans Api V1 Subscription Plans Get

get.description: Returns the user's current active subscription with plan details and expiry date. Returns null if no active subscription exists.

schema.title: Response Get Active Api V1 Subscription Active Get

post.description: For paid plans: creates a YooKassa payment and returns a redirect URL. For free or trial plans: activates immediately and returns payment_url=null. Email is required for paid plans to generate a fiscal receipt.
Marks the user's active subscription as cancelled. Does not issue refunds.
Record a contact request from the landing page. Data is stored for CRM follow-up. No authentication required.
Send FCM push to specific users or all users. Saves history for audit.

get.description: Returns the last N notification sends with delivery stats.

schema.title: Response Get Notification History Api V1 Admin Notifications History Get

get.description: Returns all registered users with basic info and subscription status.

schema.title: Response Get All Users Api V1 Admin Users Get

get.description: Returns all recorded actions for the given user, newest first.

schema.title: Response Get User Actions Api V1 Admin Users  User Id  Actions Get

get.description: Returns a complete snapshot of the user's data: profile, quiz answers, equipment, subscription.
Returns all AI chat messages for the given user, oldest first.

schema.title: Response Get User Messages Api V1 Admin Users  User Id  Messages Get

post.description: Send a text message and/or image to the user via Telegram bot.

get.summary: Daily analytics: registrations, subscribers, active users
get.description: Returns daily breakdown of registrations, new subscriptions, and active users for the given period. Use for admin dashboard charts.

post.description: Receives payment events from YooKassa. Only 'payment.succeeded' events are processed. Idempotent — duplicate events are safely ignored via DB deduplication.

post.summary: Generate a training program via AI
post.description: Uses the neural assistant to generate a personalised training program based on quiz answers, available equipment, and user patterns. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY to be configured.

post.summary: Send a message to the neural assistant
post.description: Direct access to the neural assistant for consultations. Unlike /chat/message, this endpoint bypasses intent routing and always uses the full neural consultation model.

get.description: Endpoint that serves Prometheus metrics.
Simple liveness probe — returns 200 OK when the service is running.
